verdict.rationale: Netlify documents built-in analytics for tracking project performance per deployment and visitor behavior. Nothing in the evidence shows user-built custom dashboards or aggregation of metrics from arbitrary external services. That built-in analytics is an adjacent feature and does not deliver this story. Observability dashboards are a fair question for a hosting platform, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
